metadata.description: CopilotForge: your Microsoft AI transformation team as installable AI skills.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-strategy
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Strategy. Define the organisation's AI ambition, target outcomes, principles, operating model and roadmap, starting from business outcomes rather than products.

plugins.name: copilotforge-opportunity-management
plugins.description: CopilotForge Opportunity Management. Create a disciplined path from business problem to prioritised and governed initiative, including the decision about whether AI is the right answer at all.

plugins.name: copilotforge-copilot-adoption
plugins.description: CopilotForge Copilot Adoption. Design and run organisation-wide or business-unit Microsoft AI adoption programmes, from readiness and scenarios through launch, reinforcement and measurement.

plugins.name: copilotforge-champions
plugins.description: CopilotForge Champions. Create evidence-led Champion programmes that turn curiosity into capability and capability into contribution, with clear boundaries on what Champions do and do not do.

plugins.name: copilotforge-m365-agents
plugins.description: CopilotForge Microsoft 365 Agents. Turn organisational knowledge and repeatable information needs into appropriately scoped, owned and tested agents with a managed lifecycle.

plugins.name: copilotforge-security-privacy
plugins.description: CopilotForge Security and Privacy. Reviewer-class department that assesses identity, access, data exposure, connectors, privacy and retention for AI solutions and blocks release while material risks are unresolved.

plugins.name: copilotforge-ai-centre-of-excellence
plugins.description: CopilotForge AI Centre of Excellence. Orchestrate a business-owned AI Centre of Excellence covering charter, operating model, team, governance, opportunity flow, knowledge, cadence, RACI and value measurement.

plugins.name: copilotforge-organisation-tailoring
plugins.description: CopilotForge Organisation Tailoring. Turn an organisation profile into a recommended edition and maturity archetype, a scaled programme, an ownership map and a transformation pack.
